name: Rejold's New Brew
summary: In Dun Morogh, Rejold's New Brew brings you back to Brewnall Village. After you gathered Shimmerweed, Rejold Barleybrew has perfected a new recipe and wants you, a trusted friend, to sample it.

sections.title: A Summons to Brewnall
sections.body: Tharek Blackstone and Pilot Bellowfiz, your contacts in Dun Morogh, send you back to Brewnall Village. Rejold Barleybrew has finished fermenting his experimental batches and wants to share them with the traveler who made them possible: you, after securing Shimmerweed from the bitter slopes.

sections.title: Tasting the Fruit of Labor
sections.body: Brewnall Village is known for its ale craft, and Rejold Barleybrew’s newest batch is no ordinary draught. He infused his mash with local herbs to make Shimmer Stout. Before shipping barrels to neighboring outposts and thirsty patrons in Loch Modan, Rejold insists that you, the adventurer who risked life and limb for the herbs, have the honor of the first sip.

faq.q: Who sends me back to Rejold Barleybrew?
faq.answer: Your allies in Dun Morogh, including Tharek Blackstone and Pilot Bellowfiz, tell you Rejold wants you back at Brewnall Village.
Brewnall Village lies in western Dun Morogh, along the shores of frozen Iceflow Lake.

faq.q: What is Rejold's new drink made of?
faq.answer: Rejold made his new drink by adding Shimmerweed, a wild plant from Dun Morogh’s chilly crags, to his traditional ale recipe.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Rejold?
faq.answer: Rejold offers you a sample of his new creation, then asks you to bring a barrel of Shimmer Stout to his brother Wellart, a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower on the border with Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why does Rejold want me specifically to try it?
faq.answer: You helped Rejold obtain the rare Shimmerweed for his experimental recipe, so he considers it proper dwarven courtesy to let you sample the result first.

faq.q: What is the name of the final beverage?
faq.answer: The experimental blend is called Shimmer Stout, after the key ingredient that gives it its distinct kick.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know there is little higher honor than a respected brewmaster personally summoning you to take the first pull from a fresh cask.
As an Alliance adventurer, you know hearty dwarven ales keep garrisons throughout the Eastern Kingdoms in good spirits, even at harsh frontier outposts like Dun Morogh.
